details.description: Firesearch OCR V6 is an optical character recognition model that Fireworks AI provides through its model library, built to extract text from images via an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. Fireworks' own model page lists it as a 4.54-billion-parameter base (non-instruction-tuned) model with an 8.19K-token context window, created December 11, 2024, and marks it 'Ready' for on-demand deployment. Fireworks has not published a launch post, benchmark results, or a supported-language list for this model.
advantages: Accepts image input directly through Fireworks' chat completions API for extracting text from images, per Fireworks' model page and its vision-language-model API guide.
Available for on-demand deployment on dedicated GPUs with, per Fireworks, high reliability and no rate limits.
disadvantages: Fireworks has not published benchmark results, accuracy figures, or a supported-language list for this model.
Listed as a base model rather than instruction-tuned, and does not support fine-tuning or serverless deployment, per its Fireworks model page.
No launch post or documentation beyond the model-library listing was found describing how it was trained or what it is specialized for.
use_cases: Extracting text from images, such as scanned documents or photographed text.

notes: The only source found is Fireworks' own model-library page for this model; no blog post, Hugging Face card, or third-party coverage of firesearch-ocr-v6 could be found, so this write-up is thinner than for Fireworks' other models. Bud's catalog modality facts for this entry list only text_input/text_output; Fireworks' page marks 'Support image input: Supported', which is the model's stated purpose -- flagging this discrepancy for the catalog facts to be checked.
